col.subject: Subject
priv.title: Message privacy · revision {rev}
priv.note: Rules run on a chosen assistant's send or collect path, and never rewrite published history. Source libraries stay under their original authorization.
priv.binary: Allow binary attachments that cannot be inspected
priv.customMeta: Sensitive metadata field names: one per line
priv.limits: Rules only check UTF-8 text, miss some privacy in natural language, and never inspect images, PDFs or binary content. Disallowed attachment types block the message from publishing.
priv.previewPh: Enter text to check (uses the saved rules)
priv.auditTitle: Audit · raw matches are not kept
ob.resumeSpace: Click Connect assistant first, and resume the unfinished onboarding.
ob.defaultNote: This connection can only send to you. Collect, attachment and library permissions can be granted after connecting, as needed.
ob.saveNote: Save this connection info into the assistant's runtime. The raw credential is shown once.
ob.forever: No expiry; revoke anytime under connection management.
ob.onboarded: Once connected, ask the assistant to send the first letter to the default recipient. Back in the inbox, confirm the message arrived.
ob.resume: Please resume the unfinished creation or issuance first.
ob.connNote: Each connection carries its own permissions. When issuing a new one, update the assistant's config; when narrowing permissions, also revoke the old one.
ob.only100: Only the latest 100 connections show here; the full record is under “Manage → Connections”.
ob.recipients: Extra recipients (sends only to you when none picked)
ob.own: Create this assistant its own library set
ob.ownNote: With library read/write enabled, sets this assistant owns are also in scope. Extra sets still need their matching read/write ticks.
ob.resumeOthers: Please resume the other unfinished creation or issuance first.
ob.stale: The page changed. Please reopen connection management.
ob.needMemory: Creating a library set needs a library read/write ability.
ob.needSend: Picking extra recipients needs send ability.
ob.needRead: Picked readable sets need library-read ability.
ob.needWrite: Picked writable sets need library-write ability.
ob.needSpace: Create or pick a user space first.
ob.confirmReissue: Re-issuing invalidates the old user credential and login sessions. Issue anyway?
ob.ownerNote: This credential only manages the current user space. Hand it to that user over a private channel; assistants use separately issued connection credentials.
